title: Guest Services Correction Authority on Guest Folios: Folio Status, Dispute Window and Desk Adjustment Limit
content:
Guest services corrects Guest Folio lines within three bounds — the status of the folio, the brand's dispute window and the brand's desk adjustment limit — and registers with the hotel what lies beyond them.

## 1. Status of the folio

Corrections are made only on a folio whose status is open or reopened; a settled folio is first reopened.

## 2. Dispute window

A correction to a folio whose guest has checked out is made only if it is requested no later than the brand's dispute window in calendar days after the guest checked out. Days are counted as whole calendar days from the actual check-out date, which is day zero; a request on the last day of the window is accepted.

The clock starts from the actual check-out date shown on the system record of the reservation behind the folio, and the date compared with it is the date of the guest's request.

| Hypothetical case (window of 90 calendar days) | Actual check-out date | Request date | Day | Accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Request on the last day | 1 June | 30 August | Day 90 | Yes |
| Request the day after | 1 June | 31 August | Day 91 | No |
| Request during the stay | Not yet checked out | Any | — | The window condition does not arise: it governs folios whose guest has checked out |

## 3. Desk adjustment limit

Guest services posts an adjustment only if the total it has posted on the folio, including this adjustment, does not exceed the brand's desk adjustment limit. The total counts, over the whole life of the folio up to the moment of handling, every adjustment and every elite breakfast credit recorded as posted by guest services — the lines that carry folio line number 0. A correction that would exceed the limit, a smoking cleaning fee dispute, and any dispute about damage or about whether an incidental was incurred other than a courtesy minibar removal are registered as a billing dispute referred to the hotel, and guest services posts nothing for that line.

| Hypothetical folio (limit $250.00) | Posted by guest services before | This adjustment | Total including this one | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | $120.00 | $130.00 | $250.00 | Posted (equal to the limit) |
| B | $120.00 | $130.01 | $250.01 | Not posted; registered as a billing dispute referred to the hotel |
| C | $0.00 | $40.00, a smoking cleaning fee dispute | — | Not posted; registered as a billing dispute referred to the hotel |

## 4. Outside these rules

A dispute about the room rate the guest agreed to at booking, or a request for a goodwill reduction without one of the recognised correction reasons, is outside these rules.

The brand's dispute window and desk adjustment limit for this authority are those in the Guest Folios control schedule of each brand.
